title: Optimize Web Font Loading: Master CSS 'font-display' for Superior UI & User Experience
tweet: Improve your website's perceived performance and UI stability! Learn how CSS 'font-display' optimizes web font loading for a smoother user experience. #WebFonts #CSS #UX
tip: To prevent layout shifts (CLS) and ensure a consistent UI, strategically use 'font-display: swap;' for primary content fonts. This shows fallback text immediately and swaps once the web font loads, minimizing blank text (FOIT). For critical icons or very fast loading fonts, consider 'block' or 'fallback' to minimize invisible text while gracefully preventing Flash of Unstyled Text (FOUT). Always test different values for optimal perceived performance.
